output.notes: Described the headline model, GPT-3 175B; all 8 sizes from Table 2.1 are listed. The architecture is inherited from GPT-2 except for the alternating dense and banded-sparse attention. These inherited values come from GPT-2 and are not restated in this paper: layernorm, learned positions, tanh-approximate GELU, eps 1e-5, biases, tied head and the 50257 vocabulary. d_ff values are computed from the stated rule d_ff = 4*d_model; the rule is quoted, but the numbers themselves do not appear in the text. Table 2.1 gives d_model=5140 for the 13B model, which is inconsistent with 40 heads x 128 (5120); it is kept as written. The qkv split sizes and the sparse-attention band width are not stated. The paper also refers to the largest model as '200B' in a few places but as 175B everywhere else.
